{{Quote|Ren Moru and his crew are waiting to hear your orders. What's it gonna be, boss?|Harlow Ricks|<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />}}
'''Ren Moru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitant of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with his wife [[Elloise Moru]]. In [[3642 BBY]], the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] enslaved Ren for his debt of 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and forced him to mine [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] for them. Ren spent two years in [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] before being saved by an individual pretending to be a leader of a rival pirate gang. Even before being rescued from the Nova Blades slave island, Ren and the other prisoners heard of his exploits throughout the [[Raider's Cove]], so upon being released from captivity they were looking for a chance of a payback against Nova Blades. The released slaves formed a crew under Ren and willingly pledged themselves into working for the person who granted them freedom. Still based on Rishi, they maintained contact through Ren's contact [[Harlow Ricks]], who resided at the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Raider's Cove]] and served as the intermediate between Ren's gang and their new boss, delivering to them daily orders and handing over their spoils in return. Ren's wife Elloise was happy to have her husband back and sent a letter of thanks to his rescuer as well.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />
